old_text:
Ugandan opposition leader Kizza Besigye rushed to hospital after court collapse
Issued on:
In tonight's edition: Ugandan opposition leader Kizza Besigye is in hospital after collapsing in court, raising fresh concerns over the treatment of political opponents. Ghana proposes sweeping constitutional reforms that could reshape its political landscape. Meanwhile, Benin steps up its campaign to recover looted cultural treasures and colonial archives from France.
Produced by Clarisse Fortuné and Guillaume Gougeon
